neighbours.label: first piece of a word for an outer covering layer around something (sheath, cladding, casing, outer layer)
fire: Multiple sclerosis damages the myelin sheath that protects nerve fibres.
The optical fibre has a glass core surrounded by a cladding of lower index.
Each tendon slides inside a thin synovial sheath in the wrist.
The building's aluminium cladding caught fire within minutes.
A tough outer sheath protects the copper wires inside the cable.
The sword rested in a leather sheath hanging from his belt.
The keratin sheath of the beak grows continuously in many birds.
Workers replaced the cracked cladding panels on the north wall.
quiet: Multiple sclerosis damages the signals that travel along nerve fibres.
The optical fibre has a glass core that carries light over long distances.
Each tendon connects a muscle to a bone in the wrist.
The building's wooden staircase caught fire within minutes.
Thick copper wires carry the current from the generator to the house.
The sword had a steel blade and a handle made of bone.
The tip of the beak is used for cracking seeds in many birds.
Workers replaced the cracked windows on the north wall.

notes: Top examples: myelin ' she'aths, fibrous ' she'ath, ' cl'adding, metal ' об'шивка, ' outer', ' enc'(asing). Shared pattern is an enveloping outer layer. Near misses keep the anatomy/materials text and drop the covering word.
